svg.title: Agentic decision support architecture - J&S StopOver Bar
svg.desc: Five agentic workloads run on local infrastructure under a five-tier human-in-the-loop gate, reporting to a single human owner via the CEO dashboard.
svg.text: AGENTIC DECISION SUPPORT — J&S STOPOVER BAR
One human owner. Five agents. No engineering department required.
HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP APPROVAL GATE — A TIMEOUT ESCALATES, IT NEVER AUTO-APPROVES
